cds.title: UConn Common Data Set 2025-2026 (C8A: policy for students applying for Fall 2027; C8F)

test_policy.notes: The Common Data Set (applicants for Fall 2027) marks SAT/ACT as not required but considered if submitted, and adds: 'We are test optional; only considered for students who submit and request their submission be considered'. The admissions site (admissions.uconn.edu) showed only a university emergency page on 2026-10-22, so this was not cross-checked there. No deadlines, requirements, English minimums, aid or score codes are shown for UConn because they could not be confirmed from the pages we could open.
